title: VILBIAS: DETECTING AND REASONING ABOUT BIAS IN MULTIMODAL CONTENT

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text and vision-language models on a VQA-style benchmark (ViLBias) to perform binary classification (biased vs. unbiased) on news text-image pairs and generate rationales identifying multimodal framing techniques such as loaded wording, selective presentation, and image staging.
Analyzing bias in news content across a curated dataset of diverse media outlets with varied editorial orientations and audience trust profiles (e.g., liberal vs. conservative leaning sources).

bias_targets.target: Demographic biases (Gender, Racial, Cultural, Disability, Age bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Instructing expert human annotators during the human-in-the-loop validation process to explicitly identify systematic biases, stereotypes, and skewed representations related to linguistic, visual, gender, racial, cultural, disability, and age-related attributes in the news content.
